definition: Lacking features that make someone or something easy to recognise.
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
quote: When any of these nondescript individuals put in an appearance, Sherlock Holmes used to beg for the use of the sitting-room, and I would retire to my bed-room.
example_sentence: The spy drove a nondescript grey car.
